patch.summary: ActiveCampaign migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to ActiveCampaign by inventorying legacy email-marketing fields, mapping them to ActiveCampaign objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Shopify, WordPress, Salesforce before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change.
Success signal: contact management works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: ActiveCampaign migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power contact management and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into ActiveCampaign; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Shopify; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Marketing-led SMBs that need automation as the primary email job outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change.
If ActiveCampaign mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Klaviyo before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Shopify in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change.

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: No forever-free plan — 14-day trial entry only

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Contact-tier pricing scales as the list grows — confirm live bands

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for contact management
Mitigate: Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change.

notes: Migration: cutover risks, data mapping, checklist.
